name: upwork__find_jobs
title: Find Jobs
description:
Marketplace job postings: search them by keywords and filters, get one by id, or get the jobs recommended for the freelancer's own profile (smart_search).
Actions: search, get, smart_search.
Call get_tool_help(tool_name="find_jobs") for how to use this tool.

previous_clients_only.description: Only jobs from clients you have worked with before

skills.description: Upwork skill names, at most 5, ANDed — a job must carry every one. A name that matches no Upwork skill is reported in filters_ignored and not applied; when none match, the search is refused with the closest matches

workload.description: Hours per week — distinct from duration, which is project length

budget_max.description: Fixed-price budget ceiling; does not filter hourly jobs — use rate_max for those

duration.description: Expected project length. Constrains hourly jobs only — fixed-price jobs are returned regardless of duration, so pair it with job_type=hourly to exclude them

include_full_details.description: Include each result's full untruncated job description. False by default to keep responses compact

query.description: Broad match across the whole posting, title and description, with semantic expansion — prefer title when the user names a specific kind of work

sort.description: Result order. Omit for newest-first; relevance is the default for a query-only search and is refused alongside title, skills, category or subcategory

subcategory.description: Category one level down, by name or ontology id

verified_payment_only.description: Only jobs from clients with verified payment method

budget_min.description: Fixed-price budget floor; does not filter hourly jobs — use rate_min for those

proposals_max.description: Maximum proposals already submitted, e.g. 5 for jobs with fewer than 5

rate_min.description: Hourly posted-range overlap lower endpoint. Keeps jobs whose posted maximum is at least this value; it does not require the posted minimum to meet it. For a strict floor keep only rows whose budget min is >= this; drop "up to B/hr" (no min) and no-range

client_hires_max.description: Maximum hires the client has made; 0 with client_hires_min=0 for clients who never hired

client_hires_min.description: Minimum hires the client has made

rate_max.description: Hourly posted-range overlap upper endpoint. Keeps jobs whose posted minimum is at most this value; it does not require the posted maximum to meet it. No-range jobs may appear. For a strict ceiling keep only rows whose budget max is <= this; drop "A+/hr" (no max) and no-range

title.description: Match the job title only: 1-3 key words, ANDed, stemmed, whole words. Cannot be combined with query or sort=relevance

category.description: Top-level category, by name ("Web, Mobile & Software Dev") or ontology id; an unknown name is rejected with the valid list

id.description: Job ID from find_jobs search (preferred), a ~02… ciphertext, or a full Upwork job URL — pass any of these as-is.

job_id.description: Alias for id — provide id or job_id

from_date.description: Only jobs posted on or after this date — YYYY-MM-DD, or an RFC3339 timestamp for finer granularity. Use with to_date for an explicit range; use days_posted instead for a window ending now. Applies to mode=most_recent

previous_clients_only.description: Only jobs from clients you have worked with before

rate_min.description: Hourly posted-range overlap lower endpoint. Keeps jobs whose posted maximum is at least this value; it does not require the posted minimum to meet it. For a strict floor keep only rows whose budget min is >= this; drop "up to B/hr" (no min) and no-range

to_date.description: Only jobs posted on or before this date — YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, so to_date=2026-09-03 includes all of the 3rd), or an RFC3339 timestamp. Defaults to now when only from_date is given. Applies to mode=most_recent

verified_payment_only.description: Only jobs from clients with verified payment method

cursor.description: Page cursor — the next_cursor from the previous response

days_posted.description: Only jobs posted within the last N days (days_posted=1 for "posted today"). Applies to mode=most_recent; the best_match recommender selects its own set and ignores the window. Cannot be combined with from_date/to_date

duration.description: Expected project length. Constrains hourly jobs only — fixed-price jobs are returned regardless of duration, so pair it with job_type=hourly to exclude them

mode.description: Which feed to read. best_match (default) is Upwork's personalized recommendations ranked by fit; most_recent is the newest postings matched to this freelancer, newest first. Use most_recent when the user asks for the newest, latest or just-posted jobs

rate_max.description: Hourly posted-range overlap upper endpoint. Keeps jobs whose posted minimum is at most this value; it does not require the posted maximum to meet it. No-range jobs may appear. For a strict ceiling keep only rows whose budget max is <= this; drop "A+/hr" (no max) and no-range

name: upwork__get_freelancer_financials
title: Get Freelancer Financials
description:
View your own financial data as a freelancer or agency: the balance available to withdraw right now, earnings and transaction history, connects balance, and time report. Use this to verify a payment or earnings release, or to answer how much money is currently in the account.
Actions: available_balance, summary, transactions, connects_balance, timesheets.
Call get_tool_help(tool_name="get_freelancer_financials") for the parameters and how to use this tool.

name: upwork__list_accounts
description: List your available Upwork accounts (Freelancer, Client, Agency). Call this first.

name: upwork__list_freelancer_proposals
title: List Freelancer Proposals
description:
View your freelancer proposals and received invitations. Prior proposals make good drafting examples. Note: the status 'Accepted' means the proposal was submitted and validated (NOT that the client accepted you) — each result includes a status_label with the plain-English meaning. Start with recent submitted (Accepted) proposals; when looking for the strongest templates, also check Offered/Hired examples. list shows only Accepted by default: when a proposal the user asks about is not there, also check Offered, Hired, Declined and Withdrawn before saying it does not exist, and tell them which status it was under.
Actions: list, invitations, get, get_room.
Call get_tool_help(tool_name="list_freelancer_proposals") for the parameters and how to use this tool.

name: upwork__manage_proposals
title: Manage Proposals
description:
Submit, edit, or withdraw freelancer proposals. Submitting can include a Connects boost bid for a top slot on the client's list. Also accept or decline client job invitations. For client offers, use respond_to_offer. Freelancers cannot send the first message on a proposal — see PROPOSAL MESSAGING.

WRITE OPERATION — REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER CONFIRMATION.
Returns a preview — call confirm_preview only after explicit user approval.
Actions: create, accept_invitation, start_ai_interview, decline_invitation, withdraw, edit, send_proposal, acknowledge_policy.
Call get_tool_help(tool_name="manage_proposals") for the parameters and how to use this tool.
